How a project runs.

A clear order of work, so you always know what comes next.

Brief and site visit

We visit the plot, measure it and note your needs and budget.

Concept and 3D views

You see plans and 3D renders of your building before anything is built.

Drawings and approvals

Structural and working drawings, ready for panchayat or corporation submission.

Construction and handover

Supervised site work, then a final walkthrough with you.
